description: Prompt studio: see the state of the interview and exam prompts — what is in effect now, the user’s saved custom prompt, the official version and whether it has been updated, each built-in style, and built-in exam questions for trial runs. Returns an overview with lengths; pass show to read one text in full. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope interviews:read.)

lang.description: Interview language to render for; defaults to the saved one

show.description: Which text to return in full: current / saved / official / style:<value>
